arguments.recommended_next_step: Verify job processing pipeline and add validation to prevent malformed rows; monitor queue depth and retry logic.
arguments.summary: Exported failed_jobs table via pg_dump. Identified 47 malformed rows causing retry queue block. Deleted them, unblocking queue. Still 1,388 failures; need to investigate root cause. Also noted connection pool exhaustion and replica lag. Recommend adding validation and monitoring.
